q831463ce.a: I define a hypothesis and one primary metric, compute the sample size, randomise users, and run for the planned time. I read both the p-value and the effect size and confidence interval, and avoid peeking early or testing too many metrics.
q831463ce.q: How do you design and read an A/B test?
q831463ce.w: Hypothesis, sample size, randomization, p-value and effect size, pitfalls like peeking.

q83e25491.a: I keep a risk register with the probability, impact, owner, mitigation and trigger for each risk. We review it in each status meeting, escalate the high ones early, and track mitigation as normal tasks. I also keep a contingency in time or budget for the risks that remain.
q83e25491.w: Risk register, probability and impact, owners, mitigation, reviews.

q8407c549.a: Example (use your own): "A script gave wrong totals only on some days. I added logging and found a timezone issue in date comparison. It took a day because it only happened near midnight. I fixed it with UTC dates, added a test for that case and wrote the finding in the team notes." Show your method: reproduce, narrow, test.
q8407c549.q: Tell me about a bug that took you a long time to find.

q847681bb.a: == compares references, whether two variables point to the same object. equals() compares the content when a class overrides it. The contract: if two objects are equal, they must return the same hashCode. If you override equals() and not hashCode(), HashMap and HashSet will not find your objects correctly.
q847681bb.q: Explain the difference between == and equals(), and why hashCode matters.
q847681bb.w: Reference vs value equality, the contract, HashMap behavior.

q84c299ac.a: I split code by route, lazy load heavy components, memoise only where measurements show it helps, optimise images, and keep the bundle small by removing unused libraries. I measure with Lighthouse and the browser profiler, and set a performance budget.
q84c299ac.q: How do you keep a React or Angular app fast?
q84c299ac.w: Code splitting, memoization, lazy loading, bundle size, measuring with Lighthouse.

q84f27e55.a: I choose metrics by the goal: CTR (click-through rate), CPC (cost per click), conversion rate, CPA (cost per acquisition), ROAS (return on ad spend) and bounce rate. I report the ones that link to business results, such as leads or sales, not just likes and impressions.
q84f27e55.q: How do you measure a campaign? Which metrics matter?
q84f27e55.w: CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS, bounce rate. Link metrics to the business goal.

q84f5ae13.a: Use STAR: Situation, Task, Action, Result. Example: "In [project] I [mistake, e.g. missed a deadline because I underestimated the work]. I told my manager early, fixed the most important part first, and delivered the rest a day later. Since then I add a buffer to my estimates and share progress daily." Own the mistake and show what you changed.
q84f5ae13.q: Tell me about a time you failed.
q84f5ae13.w: Own it, show the lesson and what you changed.

q853e349d.a: My typing speed is around [your speed] words per minute with good accuracy. If you do not know your speed, say: I am good at typing and I practise regularly.
q853e349d.w: Give your real number from a typing test. This is a quick-check question, so be honest.

q867774de.a: Example (use your own): "A friend could not fill an online form for a scholarship. I sat with him, read the instructions, and we filled it correctly step by step. He submitted before the deadline. I learned that patience and clear steps help people."
q867774de.h: Chhoti kahani: problem, aapne kya kiya, natija.
q867774de.q: Tell me about a time you helped someone solve a problem.

q868eec25.a: TCP is connection-oriented and reliable, with ordering and retransmission, used for web, email and file transfer. UDP is connectionless and faster with no guarantees, used for voice, video and DNS where late data is worse than lost data.
q868eec25.q: What is the difference between TCP and UDP, and when do you use each?
q868eec25.w: Reliability vs speed, examples like web vs voice.

q890d73c2.a: IATA is the International Air Transport Association. DEL is Delhi, BOM is Mumbai and BLR is Bengaluru. These are three-letter airport codes used on tickets and baggage tags.
q890d73c2.h: IATA airline sangathan. DEL = Delhi, BOM = Mumbai, BLR = Bengaluru.
q890d73c2.q: What is IATA? What do the codes DEL, BOM and BLR mean?
q890d73c2.w: IATA = International Air Transport Association. DEL = Delhi, BOM = Mumbai, BLR = Bengaluru.

q89c55a58.a: Example (use your own numbers): "A report API took 8 seconds. I profiled it and found an N+1 query problem. I used a join fetch and added an index, and cached the stable part. Response time dropped to 900 ms, and I added a load test to guard it." Always say how you measured before and after.
q89c55a58.q: Describe a time you improved the performance of an application.
q89c55a58.w: Measure before and after with numbers.

q89d44819.a: "While I speak the announcement or follow the video, I show the seat belt, the oxygen mask, the life jacket and the exits clearly with my hands, and face the passengers. I stay calm, smile and make eye contact."
q89d44819.h: Seat belt, oxygen mask, life jacket, exits dikhana - passengers ki taraf dekhkar.
q89d44819.q: What do you do during a safety demonstration?
q89d44819.w: Show seat belt, oxygen mask, life jacket and exits clearly while speaking, facing the passengers.

q8a382af2.a: I plan data cleansing, run mock loads, and reconcile counts and balances with the source. Then user acceptance testing, a cutover plan with a time schedule and rollback, and hypercare support after go-live.
q8a382af2.q: How do you plan data migration and testing for a go-live?
q8a382af2.w: Cleansing, mock loads, reconciliation, UAT, cutover plan, hypercare.

q8b7c3d6a.a: HR functions include recruitment, onboarding, payroll and attendance, employee relations, training and development, performance management and compliance with labour laws.
q8b7c3d6a.q: What are the main functions of HR?
q8b7c3d6a.w: Recruitment, onboarding, payroll, attendance, employee relations, training, compliance.

q8bc3808f.a: I build in scoped applications and move changes with update sets or, better, with source control and the application repository. I test in a sub-production instance first and always have a back-out plan.
q8bc3808f.q: How do you move and control changes between instances?
q8bc3808f.w: Update sets vs app repository and source control, scoped apps, testing, back-out plan.

q8c672ff9.a: I go layer by layer: check the link and cable, the IP address and gateway, ping the gateway and then an external IP, check DNS, then firewall and NAT rules, and finally the ISP. I use ping, traceroute, nslookup and interface counters.
q8c672ff9.q: How do you troubleshoot a site that cannot reach the internet?
q8c672ff9.w: Layer by layer: link, IP, gateway, DNS, firewall, ISP. Name your tools.

q8df8b7a7.a: [Your city] is a [metro city] in [your state]. Many companies, shopping malls, showrooms and universities are here. It is a very good city.
q8df8b7a7.h: [Brackets] mein apni jaankari daaliye. 4-5 aasaan sentences.
q8df8b7a7.w: Replace the [brackets] with your own details. Keep it to 4-5 simple sentences.

q8ec84040.a: I check the transaction logs and the performance tools to see where the time goes: client scripts on load, business rules, large related lists or slow queries. I disable or optimise the slow part, test again, and make sure it works for users with different roles.
q8ec84040.q: A form is slow to load. How do you find out why?
q8ec84040.w: Transaction logs, client scripts, business rules, onLoad scripts, related lists.

q9024c3b4.a: "I would not touch the bag. I would ask nearby people if it belongs to them and move people away from it. I would inform security and my supervisor immediately."
q9024c3b4.h: Haath mat lagao, aas-paas poochho, security aur supervisor ko turant batao.
q9024c3b4.q: You see an unattended bag at the gate. What do you do?
q9024c3b4.w: Do not touch. Ask nearby people if it is theirs, move people away, inform security and your supervisor at once.

q90532e8a.a: I ask three questions: who uses it, which decisions it should support, and which two or three numbers matter most. I build a small first version with those numbers, share it, and improve it with feedback. I tell the manager what is in the first version and what comes next.
q90532e8a.q: A manager asks for a dashboard by tomorrow with unclear requirements.
q90532e8a.w: Ask 3 key questions, ship a small version, iterate.

q913aa9c8.a: Example (use your own): "I built [a small shop site] with PHP and MySQL. I did the database and the checkout, used prepared statements for security, and fixed a slow page by adding an index. It is live at [link] and the code is on GitHub." Be ready to explain every part.
q913aa9c8.q: Tell me about a project you built in PHP.
q913aa9c8.w: Problem, your part, tools, one challenge, result. Offer a GitHub link.

q914ad205.a: I do not sort only by severity score. I consider exploitability (is there a known exploit), asset criticality, internet exposure and compensating controls. Then I set SLAs by tier, such as critical and exposed in a few days, and track closure with the owners.
q914ad205.q: How do you prioritize 5,000 vulnerabilities from a scan?
q914ad205.w: Exploitability, asset criticality, exposure, compensating controls, SLAs.

q921d93ce.a: An Activity is a screen entry point, a Fragment is a reusable part of a screen with its own lifecycle that lives inside an Activity. Fragments help in navigation, tablets and reusing UI. Modern apps often use one Activity with the Navigation component.
q921d93ce.q: What is the difference between an Activity and a Fragment?
q921d93ce.w: Screen vs reusable part of a screen, why fragments help on tablets and navigation.

q926aecda.a: "I would stay calm, check the passenger and call the senior crew member. I would ask on the announcement if a doctor is on board, use the first aid kit or oxygen as per my training, and inform the cockpit crew. I would keep the passenger comfortable until help arrives."
q926aecda.h: Shaant raho, senior crew ko batao, doctor ki announcement, first aid, cockpit ko batao.
q926aecda.q: A passenger feels sick or faints in flight. What will you do?
q926aecda.w: Stay calm, check, call senior crew and ask for a doctor on board, use first aid kit/oxygen as trained, tell the cockpit.

q9321cdee.a: In a voice process I talk to customers on the phone, so clear speaking and listening are important. In a non-voice process I help customers by chat, email or typing, so writing and accuracy are important. I am comfortable with [voice or non-voice] because [my reason, for example "I speak clearly and enjoy talking to people"], and I am ready to learn the other too.
q9321cdee.h: Voice = call par baat. Non-voice = chat/email/typing. Apni pasand wajah ke saath.
q9321cdee.q: What is the difference between a voice process and a non-voice process?

q934b4514.a: I would use WebSockets or server-sent events to push messages, a queue to decouple producers from delivery, and a database to store notifications for users who are offline. For scale I run multiple instances with a shared broker like Redis, add retries and acknowledgements, and let users control preferences.
q934b4514.q: Design a real-time notifications feature end to end.
q934b4514.w: WebSockets or SSE, queue, persistence, scale-out, retries, offline users.

q9471d4cb.a: I prefer httpOnly, secure, same-site cookies for the session or refresh token, because JavaScript cannot read them, which reduces XSS risk, and add CSRF protection. If I use tokens in headers, I keep access tokens short-lived and in memory, and rotate refresh tokens. I always use HTTPS.
q9471d4cb.q: How do you handle authentication and sessions in a SPA with an API?
q9471d4cb.w: Token vs cookie, httpOnly, refresh, CSRF and XSS tradeoffs.

q96277925.a: I check must-have skills and experience against the job description, look at stability, communication and any red flags, and then shortlist and share with the hiring manager for feedback. I keep a tracker so every candidate gets a response.
q96277925.q: How do you screen a resume and shortlist candidates?
q96277925.w: Must-have skills, experience fit, stability, communication, red flags. Check with the hiring manager.

q98bc3940.a: Page Object Model keeps the locators and actions of each page in one class, and the tests only call those methods. If the UI changes, I fix one page class and not fifty tests. Example: a LoginPage class with login(user, password), and every test calls it. It makes tests shorter, readable and cheaper to maintain.
q98bc3940.q: Explain the Page Object Model and why you use it.
q98bc3940.w: Separate locators and actions from tests. Give one real example and the maintenance benefit.

q98c4e513.a: I set fixed overlap hours for meetings, use written daily updates, and make handoffs explicit with owners and a done checklist. A shared board shows status, so nobody waits for an email. I rotate meeting times so one side is not always inconvenienced, and I name one owner per task.
q98c4e513.q: How do you manage offshore and onshore teams across time zones?
q98c4e513.w: Overlap hours, clear handoffs, written updates, ownership.

q9a8a26f8.a: Releases feel scary because they are big and manual. I make changes smaller and more frequent, add automated tests, use feature flags to separate deploy from release, and make rollback one click. I track deployment frequency and failure rate to show improvement.
q9a8a26f8.q: Deployment frequency is low because releases are scary. What do you do?
q9a8a26f8.w: Smaller changes, automated tests, feature flags, safe rollback.

q9af28cc9.a: [Your hometown] is a small place, and [your city] is a big city. We get many things in the city that we cannot get in the town, like shopping malls, hospitals with the best equipment and many universities.
q9af28cc9.h: [Brackets] mein apni jaankari daaliye. 4-5 aasaan sentences.
q9af28cc9.q: Compare your hometown and your city.
q9af28cc9.w: Replace the [brackets] with your own details. Keep it to 4-5 simple sentences.

q9bda1a63.a: I use resource controllers with form request validation, authentication with Sanctum or JWT, correct status codes, pagination and API resources for output. I rate limit, hide internal errors and write tests for the endpoints.
q9bda1a63.q: How do you build and secure a REST API in Laravel?
q9bda1a63.w: Resource controllers, validation, auth with Sanctum or JWT, status codes.

q9c250600.a: I use Scrum of Scrums or a similar sync, a shared board of dependencies, and a common cadence such as program increments in SAFe. Teams own their work, and risks across teams are visible and reviewed regularly.
q9c250600.q: How do you scale Agile across several teams and dependencies?
q9c250600.w: Scrum of Scrums, SAFe or LeSS basics, program increments, shared board, risk.

q9c2e2b2e.a: Example (use your own): "In my college function, I was in the welcome team. We shared the work, and I helped guests find their seats. The event went well and I learned that teamwork and listening make work easier."
q9c2e2b2e.h: School, college, ghar ka ek example: aapka role aur natija.
q9c2e2b2e.q: Tell me about a time you worked in a team.
q9c2e2b2e.w: A simple story from school, college, a function or home: your role, the work, the result.

q9d686bb0.a: I call the candidate to understand the reason and see if I can help, for example with a joining date or documents. If the candidate is not joining, I tell the manager and move to the backup candidate. I note the reason and improve the process, such as better follow-up before the date.
q9d686bb0.q: A selected candidate does not join on the date. What do you do?
q9d686bb0.w: Call, find the reason, offer help, keep a backup candidate, learn for the future.

q9e8a843e.a: I use redundant links per site, SD-WAN or MPLS with a VPN backup, HSRP or VRRP for gateway redundancy, and VLAN segmentation. The data center has redundant core switches and firewalls. I add monitoring and a documented IP plan.
q9e8a843e.q: Design a network for two offices and a data center with redundancy.
q9e8a843e.w: Dual links, SD-WAN or MPLS, VPN, HSRP or VRRP, segmentation, monitoring.

q9e8cf3ec.a: I ask for a knowledge transfer and documentation immediately, re-plan the sprint with what is realistic, and tell stakeholders about the impact and the new date if needed. I start a backfill and move the critical work to a teammate with pairing for the handover.
q9e8cf3ec.w: Knowledge transfer, re-plan, inform stakeholders, backfill.

q9eb47684.a: Talk to the customer (a phone call is often quicker and more personal than a standard email or letter). Find out the problem and the requirement by listening carefully. Ask about wider issues with open questions, such as "Are you happy with our service or product?" Offer something back, such as an offer, discount or coupon, if there is a real issue and a chance of losing the customer. Confirm your solution with a follow-up email or letter to avoid disputes. Follow up regularly, and ask a team member to check that all is well.
q9eb47684.q: How can you resolve the problem to the customer's satisfaction?

q9f614b91.a: Two things are most important for a manager to succeed: my team should be happy and keep performing, and the project I am working on with my team should finish successfully with minimum problems.
q9f614b91.q: What are the most important things for you as a manager?

q9fc7e50b.a: Example (use your own): "Two team members disagreed about how to do a story. I listened to each, then facilitated a short session on the goal and options, and the team chose a way to try. I did not decide for them, and in retro we agreed a rule for such cases." Show servant leadership.
q9fc7e50b.q: Tell me about a conflict in a team and how you handled it.
q9fc7e50b.w: STAR. A servant leader facilitates, does not dictate.

qa0a5e9cb.a: I detect it with schema checks, stop bad data going downstream by quarantining the new records, and contact the owning team. I propose data contracts and versioned schemas with notice before changes, and add contract tests in their pipeline.
qa0a5e9cb.q: An upstream team changes a schema without notice.
qa0a5e9cb.w: Detect, contract tests, quarantine, talk to owner, versioning.

qa0fce40f.a: I get angry when I am falsely accused of something I did not do. Lack of order and discipline also irritates me, but I have learned to cope and adjust with other people.

qa1373dcf.a: "Ground staff do the check-in, weigh and tag baggage, give boarding passes, manage boarding at the gate, help passengers with special needs, make announcements and give updates about delays."
qa1373dcf.h: Check-in, boarding pass, baggage, gate boarding, madad, delay ki jaankari.
qa1373dcf.w: Check-in, boarding pass and baggage, gate boarding, passenger help, special-assistance, announcements, flight-delay updates.

qa2ed148c.a: var is function scoped and hoisted with the value undefined. let and const are block scoped and sit in the temporal dead zone until their line runs, so using them early throws an error. const cannot be reassigned, though an object it holds can still change. I use const by default, let when I must reassign, and avoid var.
qa2ed148c.q: Explain the difference between let, const and var, and hoisting.

qa35a5eec.a: "As a fresher, I expect the salary as per company standards. My main aim is to learn and grow with training and good work."
qa35a5eec.w: As a fresher, "as per company standards". Say you want training and growth.

qa692dade.a: My greatest strength is my ability to learn things quickly. or "I think my greatest strength is my positive attitude, even in the hardest times."

qa694c1e4.a: First I block public access on the bucket (and account level) to stop exposure. Then I review access logs and CloudTrail to see who accessed what, and rotate any secrets found inside. I report it per policy, and add preventive controls: Block Public Access, Config rules and alerts.
qa694c1e4.q: An S3 bucket was found public. What are your first steps?
qa694c1e4.w: Block access, assess exposure with logs, rotate secrets, report, add preventive controls.

qa7147373.a: I set a goal like leads or orders and choose the audience by location, age and interest. I create two or three creatives with a clear offer, start with a small budget, and install the pixel for tracking. After a few days I pause the weak ads and put more budget on the better ones, and review weekly.
qa7147373.q: How would you run a Facebook or Instagram ad campaign for a small business?
qa7147373.w: Goal, audience, creative, budget, test variants, track with pixel, optimize weekly.

qa7627f13.a: Keep the service stateless so I can run many instances behind a load balancer. Use connection pooling, indexes and caching with Redis for hot reads, and async or queues for slow work. Add rate limiting, timeouts and circuit breakers. Measure with load tests, and expose metrics, logs and tracing so I can see bottlenecks. Scale horizontally first, then tune the database.
qa7627f13.q: Design a REST service that handles 5,000 requests per second.
qa7627f13.w: Stateless design, caching, DB pooling, async, rate limits, observability.

qa77c5789.a: INNER JOIN returns matching rows from both tables, LEFT JOIN returns all rows from the left table plus matches. To make a query faster I add indexes on columns used in WHERE and JOIN, check the plan with EXPLAIN, select only the needed columns instead of SELECT *, and avoid queries in loops.
qa77c5789.q: Explain joins in MySQL and how you make a query faster.
qa77c5789.w: Inner and left join, indexes, EXPLAIN, avoid SELECT *.

qa7e6c3c3.a: I use Figma with components, auto layout and a design system. For hand-off I name layers, document states (hover, error, empty), add spec notes and comments, and meet the developers to walk through the design.
qa7e6c3c3.q: Which design tools do you use and how do you hand off to developers?
qa7e6c3c3.w: Figma, components, auto layout, design system, specs, comments, clear states.

qa8051cbb.a: MVC separates the Model (data and rules), View (what the user sees) and Controller (handles requests). In Laravel, routes send requests to controllers, Eloquent handles the models, Blade renders views, and migrations manage the database. I would mention a real thing I built.
qa8051cbb.q: What is MVC and how does Laravel use it?
qa8051cbb.w: Model, View, Controller. Routes, Eloquent, Blade, migrations. Mention what you built.

qa82089dc.a: The Task table is the parent of Incident, Problem, Change and Request tables. The CMDB stores configuration items, such as servers and applications, and their relationships. Linking incidents and changes to CIs shows impact, so I keep CMDB data trusted with discovery and ownership.
qa82089dc.q: What are the core ServiceNow tables and how does the CMDB fit in?
qa82089dc.w: Task, incident, change, CI tables, relationships, keeping CMDB data trusted.

qa85b4f57.a: Browsing the internet. Listening to music. Chatting with friends. Reading newspapers. Reading books. Shopping. Watching movies.

qa8694129.a: GET sends data in the URL and is for reading, POST sends data in the body and is for creating or changing data. A session stores data on the server with an ID in a cookie, and a cookie stores small data in the browser. I never keep secrets in cookies and I regenerate the session ID after login.
qa8694129.q: Explain GET vs POST and how sessions and cookies work in PHP.
qa8694129.w: Data in URL vs body, session on server, cookie on client, security basics.

qa9a744f8.a: Use STAR and stay professional. Example: "A teammate and I disagreed on [how to do a task]. I listened to their reason, explained mine with facts, and we agreed on a short trial. The result was [outcome], and our working relationship became better." Never blame the other person.
qa9a744f8.q: Describe a conflict with a colleague or manager.
qa9a744f8.w: STAR, stay professional, focus on resolution.

qaa21581b.a: I am a fresher, and nothing is better for me than starting my professional career in a reputed company like yours. If everything goes well, I look forward to a long stay here, as long as the company needs me.
qaa21581b.q: How long will you work for us after we hire you?

qaa47b7d3.a: TDS is tax deducted at source: the payer deducts tax when paying certain amounts like salary, contractor payments, rent or professional fees under specific sections and rates. The deducted tax is deposited with the government on time, returns are filed, and certificates are issued to the payee. I verify rates and sections from current rules.
qaa47b7d3.q: What is TDS and where do you deduct it?
qaa47b7d3.w: Tax deducted at source, common sections, rates, deposit and return, Form 16A.

qaaba4ad8.a: Airlines use the 24-hour clock. 6 AM is 0600 hours and 6 PM is 1800 hours. You add 12 to the hour after noon, so 3 PM is 1500 and 9 PM is 2100. Practise a few times.
qaaba4ad8.q: How do you say the time in 24-hour format? What is 6 PM?
qaaba4ad8.w: Airlines use the 24-hour clock. 6 PM = 1800 hours. Practise a few.

qaafae56e.a: I check logs to find which records failed and why, and reduce the batch size or order records by parent to avoid locks. I add retry for locked records and make the job re-runnable so a rerun only processes failed records. I also look for another process locking the same parents.
qaafae56e.q: A nightly batch job fails halfway with record lock errors. What do you do?
qaafae56e.w: Logs, batch size, ordering, retries, lock causes, make it re-runnable.

qac769e51.a: I list the entities and relations, design tables with keys and indexes, and plan migrations. Then I define the API with clear resources, validation, error codes and versioning, and agree the contract with the frontend before coding. I add tests and think about how it will grow.
qac769e51.q: How do you design a database schema and API for a new feature?
qac769e51.w: Entities, relations, indexes, migrations, versioning, validation.

qacf5cb91.a: Producers put jobs on a queue like Celery with Redis or RabbitMQ. Workers retry with exponential backoff and a maximum count. Each job gets an idempotency key so repeating it does not charge or send twice. After the maximum retries it moves to a dead-letter queue with alerts. I add monitoring for queue length and failures.
qacf5cb91.q: Design a background job system with retries and idempotency.
qacf5cb91.w: Queue, workers, retry with backoff, dedupe keys, dead-letter handling.

qad1d5e40.a: UX (user experience) is how the product works and feels: flow, ease and whether the user reaches the goal. UI (user interface) is how it looks: colours, type, buttons. Example: a good checkout flow with few steps is UX; clear buttons and readable text are UI.
qad1d5e40.q: What is the difference between UI and UX?
qad1d5e40.w: UX is how it works and feels, UI is how it looks. Give a simple example.

qad3c784b.a: Example (use your own): "A nightly load failed and the sales dashboard showed old data. I fixed the job, reloaded, and told the users the timeline. Then I added freshness alerts, retries and a status message on the dashboard." Always end with prevention.
qad3c784b.q: Tell me about a pipeline failure that impacted business users.

qad668f8f.a: I define infrastructure in Terraform modules, with separate state per environment stored remotely with locking. Changes go through pull requests; terraform plan is reviewed before apply. I use variables for differences between environments and run drift detection so manual changes are found.
qad668f8f.q: How do you manage infrastructure as code with Terraform?
qad668f8f.w: State, modules, environments, plan/apply review, drift.

qae410c1a.a: I check whether the offline metric matches the business goal, whether training data differs from live data, and whether the product experience uses the prediction well. I run an A/B test and agree the success metric with the stakeholder.
qae410c1a.q: The model is accurate offline but the business sees no gain. What now?
qae410c1a.w: Check the metric, data mismatch, UX, run an A/B test, align with the stakeholder.

qaeaf050f.a: "It means we treat every guest like a god: with respect, a warm welcome and fast help. In a hotel, I would greet the guest with a smile, listen carefully and try to solve their need quickly."
qaeaf050f.h: Guest ko izzat aur madad: swagat, suno, jaldi help.
qaeaf050f.q: What does "guest is God" (Atithi Devo Bhava) mean in a hotel?
qaeaf050f.w: Guests are treated with respect and care. Greet, listen, help quickly.

qaed36713.a: "I would announce the true reason and the expected time, and apologise. I would offer water or snacks as the airline allows and update the passengers every 15 to 30 minutes. I would stay calm and polite."
qaed36713.h: Sahi jaankari, sorry, paani/snacks (rule se), baar baar update.
qaed36713.q: A flight is delayed by two hours and passengers are angry. What do you do?
qaed36713.w: Announce the truth and expected time, apologise, offer water/snacks as the airline allows, update every 15-30 minutes.

qaf1622e8.a: Secrets are stored in a vault or the CI secret manager, never in code. Pipelines use least-privilege roles. I scan code, dependencies and images, sign artifacts, and require approvals for production. Runners are isolated and logs hide secrets, and every deployment is auditable.
qaf1622e8.w: Secrets handling, least privilege, image scanning, signed artifacts, approvals.

qaf4d0def.a: Example (use your own): "I built a [profile settings] feature: the database table, the API, the React form and tests. I released it behind a flag, tracked usage, and fixed [issue]. After release [result]." Show that you owned the full slice and measured the outcome.
qaf4d0def.q: Tell me about a feature you shipped across front end and back end.
qaf4d0def.w: STAR. Show you owned the whole slice and measured the result.

qaf780621.a: For a domestic flight a passenger needs a valid photo ID and the ticket or boarding pass. For an international flight they need a passport, a visa if required and the ticket. I would check the rules of the airline to be sure.
qaf780621.h: Domestic: ID aur ticket. International: passport, visa, ticket.
qaf780621.q: What documents does a passenger need for a domestic flight? For an international flight?
qaf780621.w: Domestic: valid photo ID and ticket. International: passport and visa if needed, ticket. Tell the check-in rule from your airline.

qaffa0dae.a: Example: "Good morning. My name is [name] and I am from [city]. I have completed my [12th or graduation] in [stream]. I am polite, a good team player and I speak [languages]. I want to become cabin crew because I love serving people and I take safety seriously. Thank you." Smile and speak clearly.
qaffa0dae.h: Naam, shehar, padhai, ek khoobi aur cabin crew kyun. Muskurakar saaf bolo.
qaffa0dae.q: Tell me about yourself in English.
qaffa0dae.w: Name, city, studies, one strength (smile, teamwork, languages), why cabin crew. 5 sentences, clear voice, smile.

qb015eee9.a: I understand that teamwork is important. If someone is not serious about their work or does low-quality work that affects the whole project, I do not like it. But I try to talk to them politely and help.
qb015eee9.w: Pick a work habit, not a person, and end with how you handle it.

qb02f2986.a: Inbound: the associate receives calls about customers' queries or needs. Example: a customer calls a telecom company to ask about the current internet tariff. Outbound: the associate makes calls to customers for business or sales. Example: a bank calls to offer a personal loan.
qb02f2986.q: What are the types of call centres? What is the difference?

qb168be12.a: Spring Boot scans the classpath, and starters bring in dependencies. Auto-configuration creates beans only when conditions match, for example when a DataSource class is present and you have not defined your own. Dependency injection means Spring creates objects and passes them in, preferably through the constructor, so classes are loosely coupled and easy to test with mocks.
qb168be12.q: Explain how Spring Boot auto-configuration and dependency injection work.
qb168be12.w: Component scan, conditional beans, starters, constructor injection.

qb25b516b.a: Answer honestly. Example: "I can [or cannot yet] swim. I am comfortable with heights and small spaces. If I need swimming training for this job, I will learn it during the training and practise regularly."
qb25b516b.h: Kuch airline poochhte hain. Sach bolo, na aata ho to training mein seekhne ko bolo.
qb25b516b.q: Can you swim? Are you comfortable with heights and small spaces?
qb25b516b.w: Some airlines ask. Answer honestly. If you cannot swim, say you will learn in training.

qb2be422b.a: I adapt quickly to new situations. I am clear about my job role and mentally prepared for challenges, so I can learn fast and apply my new knowledge. In my student life, I had to clear new papers and projects every semester and I enjoyed it. I will enjoy picking up new technologies in my professional life too.
qb2be422b.q: How quickly do you adapt to new technology?

qb352c90e.a: My typing speed is around 55-60 words per minute with an accuracy rate of over 95%. I have taken regular typing tests to maintain and improve my speed and accuracy.
qb352c90e.q: What is your typing speed and accuracy?
qb352c90e.w: Change the years and tools to match your own real experience.

qb36943a3.a: Batch is cheaper and simpler and fine when data can be hours old, such as daily reports. Streaming is needed when the business must react in seconds, such as fraud alerts. I choose by the real latency requirement and cost, and often use micro-batch as a middle path.
qb36943a3.q: Batch vs streaming: how do you choose?
qb36943a3.w: Latency need, cost, complexity, a concrete example.

qb3ffe049.a: I move traffic to the redundant path or the standby switch to restore service, tell stakeholders the status, then replace or repair the switch. Afterwards I find the root cause and run a short post-incident review with actions, such as better monitoring and spare hardware.
qb3ffe049.q: A core switch fails at 2 PM on a business day.
qb3ffe049.w: Fail over, communicate, restore, root cause, post-incident review.

qb44f4917.a: It is always good to venture into new areas and new technologies. I am an adaptive person and my diligence helps me pick up new things quickly. Taking risks can give good or bad results, but the exercise itself is a great learning experience. Such experiences create experts, and I want to become a subject matter expert (SME) someday.
qb44f4917.q: Are you open to taking risks? Do you like experimenting?

qb49868e7.a: I write small functions with clear inputs and outputs and keep business logic apart from I/O. I use pytest with fixtures. I mock external boundaries like HTTP calls, payment gateways and time, but not my own business logic or the database layer where an in-memory or test database is possible. Too many mocks make tests fragile.
qb49868e7.q: How do you write testable Python code? What do you mock and what not?
qb49868e7.w: pytest, fixtures, mock external boundaries only.

qb58b7d58.a: "Safety is more important. Cabin crew are trained first for emergencies like fire, medical help and evacuation. Good service is also important, but it comes after the safety of everyone on board."
qb58b7d58.h: Safety. Cabin crew sabse pehle safety ke liye hote hain.
qb58b7d58.q: Which is more important for cabin crew: service or safety?
qb58b7d58.w: Safety. Cabin crew are first of all trained for safety; service comes next. Give a one-line reason.

qb58ebdb6.a: I compare the bank statement with the bank book entry by entry, and list the differences such as cheques issued but not yet cleared and deposits in transit, plus bank charges not yet booked. I book missing entries and prepare the bank reconciliation statement showing the balances agree.
qb58ebdb6.q: How do you do a bank reconciliation?
qb58ebdb6.w: Match the bank statement with the books, list differences like cheques not cleared, prepare the BRS.

qb7746159.a: "The main departments are Front Office (reception), Housekeeping, Food and Beverage service, Kitchen, Maintenance, Security, and Sales. They all work together to give the guest a good stay."
qb7746159.h: Front office, housekeeping, F&B service, kitchen, maintenance, security.
qb7746159.q: What are the main departments in a hotel?
qb7746159.w: Front office, housekeeping, food and beverage service, kitchen, maintenance, security, sales.

qb8cf9841.a: "At check-in I greet the passenger and check the ID and ticket. I weigh and tag the bags, give the boarding pass with the seat and gate, and tell them the boarding time. I also check any special need or document."
qb8cf9841.h: Swagat, ID/ticket, bag weight, tag, boarding pass, time batao.
qb8cf9841.w: Greet, check ID and ticket, weigh the bags, tag them, give the boarding pass with seat and gate, tell the boarding time.

qb8e91602.a: echo and print both output text; echo can take several values and is slightly faster, while print returns 1. == compares values after type conversion, and === compares value and type. I use === to avoid surprises, for example 0 == "a" can behave unexpectedly.
qb8e91602.q: What is the difference between echo and print, == and ===?
qb8e91602.w: Short answers. Then say you use === for strict comparison.

qb90bf509.a: I start with the question and the audience. Trends over time use a line chart, comparisons a bar chart, parts of a whole a simple pie or stacked bar with few items, relationships a scatter plot. I remove clutter, label clearly and put one key message in the title.
qb90bf509.q: How do you choose the right chart for a business question?
qb90bf509.w: Match chart to question, avoid clutter, one key message.

qb9794bcc.a: "Yes, I know that hotels work 24 hours, including nights and festivals. I am ready for rotational shifts and my family supports me. I will manage my rest and be on time."
qb9794bcc.h: Hotel 24x7 chalte hain. Shift, raat aur tyohar - sach boliye.
qb9794bcc.q: Are you comfortable with rotational shifts, night duty and festival work?
qb9794bcc.w: Hotels never close. Say yes if true and mention your family's support.

qb9a4419e.a: VLANs split one physical switch into separate logical networks for security and less broadcast traffic. Trunk ports carry multiple VLANs using 802.1Q tags. Spanning tree blocks redundant links to prevent loops and unblocks them on failure. Example: [a loop you traced and fixed].
qb9a4419e.q: Explain VLANs, trunking and spanning tree.
qb9a4419e.w: Segmentation, tagging, loop prevention, a troubleshooting story.

qba44f795.a: A vulnerability is a weakness, such as unpatched software. A threat is something that can exploit it, such as an attacker or malware. Risk is the likelihood that the threat uses the weakness multiplied by the impact on the business.
qba44f795.q: What is the difference between a vulnerability, a threat and a risk?
qba44f795.w: Define and link them: risk = likelihood x impact.

qba63d473.a: I open the Spark UI to find the slow stage. Usual causes are data skew, big shuffles, too many or too few partitions and many small files. Fixes: broadcast the small table in joins, salt skewed keys, tune partitions, filter early, use columnar formats like Parquet, and cache only what is reused.
qba63d473.q: A Spark job is slow. How do you tune it?
qba63d473.w: Skew, shuffles, partitions, broadcast joins, caching, file sizes.

qbb9dd73d.a: INNER JOIN keeps only rows that match in both tables. LEFT JOIN keeps all rows from the left table and the matching rows from the right, with NULL when there is no match. FULL JOIN keeps all rows from both tables, with NULL where there is no match on either side.
qbb9dd73d.q: What is the difference between INNER, LEFT and FULL joins?
qbb9dd73d.w: One-line definitions and which rows each keeps.

qbd6cf60b.a: I find keywords with Google Keyword Planner or similar tools, and pick them by search intent, volume and competition. On-page work: a keyword in the title, meta description and headings, useful content, internal links, image alt text, and fast loading on mobile.
qbd6cf60b.q: How do you do keyword research and on-page SEO?
qbd6cf60b.w: Tools like Google Keyword Planner or Ubersuggest, intent, title, meta, headings, internal links, speed.

qbdf801a2.a: I split it into candidate generation (fast retrieval of a few hundred items) and ranking (a more accurate model), with features from user and item data served within a latency budget. I log feedback to retrain, and measure impact with A/B tests, not just offline metrics.
qbdf801a2.w: Candidate generation, ranking, features, latency budget, feedback loop, A/B tests.

qc01c27ab.a: I explain the technical limit with a quick demo or screenshot, and offer the closest buildable option that keeps the intent of the design. I agree on the change with the designer in the same day, so work is not blocked, and update the design file so both sides share one version.
qc01c27ab.q: The designer's mock cannot be built as drawn. What do you do?
qc01c27ab.w: Explain constraint, offer closest option, agree quickly.

qc053bf97.a: Confidentiality means only authorised people see data, for example encryption stops a stolen laptop leaking files. Integrity means data is not changed without permission, for example hashes or checksums detect tampering. Availability means systems work when needed, for example a DDoS attack or ransomware breaks it, and backups and redundancy protect it.
qc053bf97.q: Explain the CIA triad and give a real example of each.
qc053bf97.w: Confidentiality, integrity, availability with simple incidents.

qc0c151e6.a: Use present, past, future in about 60 to 90 seconds. Example: "I am [name], a [your role] with [x years or fresher] experience. Recently I worked on [your main skill or project] and I am good at [two strengths]. Earlier I [studied or worked at ...]. I want this role because [reason linked to the job], and I want to grow in [area]." Use your own real details and practise it aloud.
qc0c151e6.w: Present, past, future in about 90 seconds, tied to this role.

qc18fa8b5.a: "My strengths are that I am polite, patient and a team player. My weakness is that I sometimes feel nervous when speaking in front of many people. I practise by speaking in front of a mirror and in group activities, and it is improving."
qc18fa8b5.h: Strength: vinamra, patient. Chhoti kamzori aur sudhaar.
qc18fa8b5.q: What are your strengths and weaknesses?
qc18fa8b5.w: Strengths: polite, patient, team player. Small real weakness plus a fix. Keep it positive.

qc2e13a4b.a: "I like working with people, and the airport is a disciplined and fast place where I can learn a lot about aviation. I enjoy helping passengers, and I want to start my career in this field and grow."
qc2e13a4b.h: Passengers se kaam, discipline, aviation seekhna - sirf plane dekhne ke liye nahi.
qc2e13a4b.q: Why do you want to work as ground staff at an airport?
qc2e13a4b.w: Say you like working with passengers, a fast and disciplined place, learning aviation. Not "only to see planes".

qc41a6e6e.a: "I keep guest information private. I never give a guest's room number or name to a stranger, and I ask the guest for permission before connecting a call. I follow the ID check process."
qc41a6e6e.h: Guest ki jaankari private. Kisi ko room number mat batao. ID check.
qc41a6e6e.q: How do you handle guest information and security?
qc41a6e6e.w: Keep it private. Never share room numbers or names with strangers. Check ID.

qc4f1c7a8.a: "At check-in I greet the guest, check the ID proof, complete the registration, give the room key and tell them about breakfast time and Wi-Fi. At check-out I prepare the bill, collect the key, thank the guest and ask for feedback."
qc4f1c7a8.h: Check-in: swagat, ID, form, chaabi, facilities. Check-out: bill, chaabi, dhanyawad, feedback.
qc4f1c7a8.q: What happens at guest check-in? And check-out?
qc4f1c7a8.w: Check-in: greet, ID proof, registration, room key, tell about breakfast and Wi-Fi. Check-out: bill, collect key, thank the guest, ask for feedback.

qc60890c1.a: Example (use your own): "I recently saw [movie name]. It is a story about [one-line story]. I liked it because [reason, for example the message about family or hard work]." Pick a movie you really saw and be ready to say the main message.
qc60890c1.q: Which movie did you see last? Tell me something about it.

qc6fb8991.a: Link growth to the role and stay realistic. Example: "In five years I want to be a strong [senior version of this role] who can guide others. I plan to keep learning [relevant skills] and take bigger responsibility step by step. I hope to do this with a company like yours."
qc6fb8991.q: Where do you see yourself in five years?
qc6fb8991.w: Growth tied to the role, honest and realistic.

qc705074a.a: Example (use your own): "Two developers disagreed on the design approach and it slowed the sprint. I spoke to each separately, then brought them together with the goal and the facts. We chose one approach with a review point. The sprint recovered, and I learned to set decision rules earlier."
qc705074a.q: Tell me about a conflict in your team and how you resolved it.
qc705074a.w: STAR with the outcome and what you learned.

qc71f5244.a: The lifecycle is preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned. Example: a malware alert on a laptop - isolate it, identify the infection path, remove it, restore from a clean image, then update controls. I keep a timeline and communicate calmly with owners.
qc71f5244.q: Describe the incident response lifecycle with a real or example incident.
qc71f5244.w: Prepare, detect, contain, eradicate, recover, lessons learned. Stay calm and structured.

qc732e1a6.a: I use REST APIs or platform events, with named credentials for authentication. For heavy calls I use async Apex or queueable jobs, handle retries, and log errors in a custom object. I use external IDs for upserts so repeats do not create duplicates.
qc732e1a6.q: How would you integrate Salesforce with an external ERP?
qc732e1a6.w: REST or platform events, named credentials, async Apex, retries, error logging, idempotency.

qc753b43b.a: A voucher is the entry of a single transaction, such as a payment, receipt, sales or purchase. A ledger is the account that collects all the entries for one party or head and shows its balance.
qc753b43b.q: What is the difference between a voucher and a ledger in Tally?
qc753b43b.w: Voucher records a transaction, ledger shows the account summary.

qc8115d8b.a: An international BPO serves customers outside India, for example in the US or UK. The work is often in night shifts because of their time zone. A call centre is one kind of BPO that handles customer calls.
qc8115d8b.w: Say it in your own words. Mention that you are ready for shifts.

qc8531d47.a: Sir, I am a self-motivated person. As a fresher, I need a platform to use my knowledge. If you give me a chance, I will give my best for your company.

qc8eeca5f.a: I do not decide by feeling. I sort the failures by risk: which are in critical flows like payment and login, which are known flaky tests, which are test data issues. I re-run the suspect ones. Then I give a clear recommendation with numbers, for example "3 real bugs in checkout, so no-go, the rest are flaky". The business owner takes the final decision with that data, and I document it.
qc8eeca5f.q: The release is tomorrow and 15% of regression is failing. What is your call?
qc8eeca5f.w: Triage by risk, separate real bugs from flakiness, give a clear go/no-go with data.

qc925692f.a: My family is a small family with [number] members. My father is a [occupation] and takes good care of our family. My mother is a [occupation]. We are a small family, but we always spend good time together.
qc925692f.h: [Brackets] mein apni jaankari daaliye. 4-5 aasaan sentences.
qc925692f.w: Replace the [brackets] with your own details. Keep it to 4-5 simple sentences.

qc93ac58d.a: I do not drop the price first. I ask what they are comparing with and what worries them. Then I show the value and return on investment, compare fairly with alternatives, and offer options such as a smaller package or payment terms. If the price still does not fit, I stay polite and keep the relationship.
qc93ac58d.q: A customer says 'your price is too high'. What do you say?
qc93ac58d.w: Do not drop price first. Find the real concern, show value and ROI, compare fairly, offer options.

qca1deab4.a: IAM users are long-term identities, roles are temporary identities assumed by services or people, and policies are JSON documents that allow or deny actions. Least privilege means giving only the permissions needed. I prefer roles over access keys, require MFA, and review permissions with Access Analyzer.
qca1deab4.q: Explain IAM users, roles and policies, and least privilege.
qca1deab4.w: Roles over keys, scoped policies, MFA, one real example.

qcb42d593.a: I run workshops with business users, confirm what standard SAP covers, and list the gaps. Gaps become RICEFW items (reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows) with a priority, and I get business sign-off before building.
qcb42d593.q: How do you gather requirements and do fit-gap analysis?
qcb42d593.w: Workshops, standard first, gaps, RICEFW list, sign-off.

qcb751f78.a: "I would explain politely and check the seat map. I would offer the nearest option or ask another passenger kindly if they are happy to change, but I would never argue."
qcb751f78.h: Samjhao, seat map dekho, nazdeeki option, bahas nahi.
qcb751f78.q: A passenger insists on a window seat that is already taken. What will you do?
qcb751f78.w: Explain, check the seat map, offer the nearest option or ask another passenger kindly, never argue.

qcc6a4a7f.a: synchronized gives mutual exclusion and visibility with a simple block or method. volatile only guarantees visibility of one variable and no caching in threads, but not atomic compound actions like count++. ReentrantLock gives more control: tryLock, timeouts, fairness and multiple conditions. I use volatile for flags, synchronized for simple critical sections, and ReentrantLock when I need those extra features.
qcc6a4a7f.q: What are the differences between synchronized, volatile and ReentrantLock?
qcc6a4a7f.w: Visibility vs atomicity, fairness, when each is enough.

qccaae723.a: I make sure the party ledger, purchase ledger and GST ledgers (CGST and SGST for local purchases, IGST for inter-state) exist. I pass a purchase voucher with the party, invoice number, items and tax, then check that the amounts and GST match the invoice.
qccaae723.q: How do you record a purchase with GST in Tally?
qccaae723.w: Create ledgers, purchase voucher, CGST and SGST or IGST, party details, check the entry.

qcef0e931.a: Can I know about my role in detail?
qcef0e931.q: Do you have any questions for us?
qcef0e931.w: Never say "no". Ask about your role, the training or the shift timings.

qcfdd49e7.a: I spread across multiple Availability Zones with a load balancer and auto scaling, use health checks, managed multi-AZ databases and backups. I define the recovery time and recovery point objectives, and test failover regularly.
qcfdd49e7.q: How do you build highly available and fault tolerant systems on AWS?
qcfdd49e7.w: Multi-AZ, auto scaling, load balancer, health checks, backups, RTO and RPO.

qd026aac2.a: AHT means average handling time, the average time spent on one call or chat, including the talk and the notes after. It matters because it shows how many customers the team can help. But speed is not enough, I must also give the correct solution so the customer does not call again.
qd026aac2.h: Ek call par lagne wala average time. Speed ke saath sahi jawab bhi zaroori.
qd026aac2.q: What is AHT (average handling time) and why does it matter?

qd1f708c8.a: I believe this job will build my confidence and improve my skills. I would love to grow with your company. I am not leaving my studies. I will continue my studies along with work.
qd1f708c8.q: Why do you want to join us and not go for higher studies?

qd20e01bc.a: I group revenue by customer and month, then use a window function: SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer ORDER BY month) for the running total, and RANK() to find top customers per month. I am careful with date truncation and time zones.
qd20e01bc.q: Write or describe SQL to find the top customers by month with a running total.
qd20e01bc.w: Window functions, group by, careful date handling.

qd47a697d.a: SEO (search engine optimisation) improves a website to rank in organic results. It is free per click but takes weeks or months. SEM is paid search advertising such as Google Ads, with instant visibility, and you pay per click. Good strategy uses both.
qd47a697d.q: What is the difference between SEO and SEM?
qd47a697d.w: Organic vs paid search. Mention keywords, ranking time, cost.

qd4844c6c.a: I worked well with my team. When there were issues, I spoke openly with my team members and my team leader and focused on finishing the work properly.
qd4844c6c.q: Tell us about your team mates and your team.
qd4844c6c.w: Stay positive. Do not complain about colleagues.

qd491afd4.a: I keep metadata in Git and deploy with SFDX or DevOps Center through the sandbox chain (dev, QA, UAT, production), with CI running tests. Test classes need 75 percent coverage, but I write meaningful assertions on behaviour and bulk cases, not just coverage.
qd491afd4.q: How do you deploy and test changes across sandboxes?
qd491afd4.w: SFDX or DevOps Center, Git, CI, test classes with 75% coverage but meaningful asserts.

qd4ba10a5.a: CI/CD automates the path from commit to production. A typical pipeline: checkout, build, unit tests, static analysis and security scan, build a container image, deploy to staging, run integration tests, approval, then deploy to production with rollback. Tools could be Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
qd4ba10a5.q: What is CI/CD and what does your pipeline look like?
qd4ba10a5.w: Stages: build, test, scan, deploy, with a real tool example.

qd5735b36.a: Bias is error from a model too simple to capture the pattern (underfitting). Variance is error from a model too sensitive to the training data (overfitting). I balance them with model complexity, regularisation, more data and cross-validation.
qd5735b36.w: Underfit vs overfit with a simple example and how you balance them.

qd6249857.a: I plan the CIDR range, create public subnets for load balancers with an internet gateway and private subnets for apps and databases, with a NAT gateway for outbound access. Security groups act on instances and are stateful, NACLs act on subnets and are stateless. I use VPC endpoints to reach AWS services privately.
qd6249857.q: How do you design a VPC with public and private subnets?
qd6249857.w: CIDR plan, NAT, route tables, security groups vs NACLs, endpoints.

qd639d11a.a: Procure-to-pay: purchase requisition, purchase order, goods receipt, invoice verification, payment. The goods receipt and the invoice post to finance. Order-to-cash: sales order, delivery, goods issue, billing, customer payment, and billing posts to accounts receivable.
qd639d11a.q: Walk me through a procure-to-pay or order-to-cash flow in SAP.
qd639d11a.w: Documents and postings at each step, where it hits finance.

qd6c60a4d.a: Business rules run on the server, before or after a database action, or async. Client scripts run in the browser on form events. UI policies show, hide or make fields mandatory without code. Flow Designer is for no-code or low-code process automation. I choose the simplest option and prefer Flow where possible.
qd6c60a4d.q: Business rule vs client script vs UI policy vs flow: when do you use each?
qd6c60a4d.w: Server vs client, timing (before, after, async), prefer no-code Flow when possible.

qd7152883.a: My current goal is to find a career position that ensures continued growth and new challenges every day. Three years from now, I see myself as an experienced and reliable senior member of the team. Five years from now, I expect to be ready for managerial responsibilities. I want a stable career in a single organisation, and I hope to get that wherever I start.
qd7152883.q: Where do you see yourself in 3 years? In 5 years?

qd72f5e05.a: An interface defines a contract with no state, and a class can implement many interfaces. An abstract class can have fields, constructors and shared code, but a class can extend only one. Since Java 8 interfaces can have default methods. I use an interface when unrelated classes share behaviour, and an abstract class when related classes share state and code.
qd72f5e05.q: What is the difference between an interface and an abstract class in Java?
qd72f5e05.w: Multiple inheritance of type, default methods, state. Give when you pick each.

qd826d851.a: I never guess. I say, "Let me check that for you, please stay on the line," and look in the guide or knowledge base. If I cannot find it, I ask my team lead and then give the customer the correct answer or a clear time when I will call back.
qd826d851.h: Andaza mat lagao. "Let me check" boliye, guide dekho ya team lead se poochho.
qd826d851.q: You do not know the answer to a customer's question. What do you do?

qdaa3ef18.a: I bring both stakeholders together with the facts and use business value and company goals to decide. If they still disagree, I escalate to the sponsor or the person who owns the decision, and then record the decision in writing and share it with both. I do not choose a side privately.
qdaa3ef18.q: Two senior stakeholders give you conflicting priorities.
qdaa3ef18.w: Bring them together, use business value, get one decision owner.

qdadb463b.a: Yes, I am comfortable working in a team. I can also work independently without supervision.
qdadb463b.q: Are you comfortable working in a team?
qdadb463b.w: Add one short example from school, college or home.

qdadd0db5.a: A decorator is a function that wraps another function to add behaviour without changing its code, for example logging, timing or authentication checks. A generator uses yield to produce values one at a time, so a big file can be read line by line without loading all of it into memory. I used them for [your use case, e.g. a timing decorator and a CSV reader].
qdadd0db5.q: Explain decorators and generators with a use case.
qdadd0db5.w: Wrapping behavior, lazy iteration, a real example from your work.

qdb6cbf7f.a: Progress against plan (burn-up or velocity), budget spent versus forecast, top risks and issues, quality (defects, test pass rate), blockers needing decisions, and the forecast completion date. I keep the report to one page and highlight what I need from stakeholders.
qdb6cbf7f.q: Which metrics do you report to stakeholders?
qdb6cbf7f.w: Velocity or burn-up, budget, risks, quality, blockers, forecast.

qdc7dc0f8.a: I use DENSE_RANK over a partition by department ordered by salary descending, and filter rank = 2: SELECT * FROM (SELECT dept, name, salary, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) r FROM emp) t WHERE r = 2. DENSE_RANK handles ties correctly, while ROW_NUMBER would not.
qdc7dc0f8.q: Write or explain a query for the second highest salary per department.
qdc7dc0f8.w: Window functions (DENSE_RANK) vs subquery; mention ties.

qdca38bef.a: I define the API with Retrofit, call it in a coroutine from the ViewModel, expose the result as StateFlow or LiveData, and show the list in RecyclerView or Compose LazyColumn. I handle loading, empty and error states.
qdca38bef.q: How do you call an API and show data in a list?
qdca38bef.w: Retrofit, coroutines, ViewModel, LiveData or StateFlow, RecyclerView or Compose.

qdcb8f935.a: I send the request with Postman or RestAssured and check the status code, the response body against a schema, important headers, and response time. I also test negative cases like missing fields, wrong types, expired token and no permission, and check that repeating a PUT or DELETE is safe. For data changes I confirm the result in the database or with a follow-up GET.
qdcb8f935.q: How do you test REST APIs? What do you assert besides status code?
qdcb8f935.w: Schema, headers, response time, negative cases, auth, idempotency. Name your tool (Postman, RestAssured).

qde3c2e88.a: Answer honestly. Example: "I speak [Hindi, English and other languages]. My English is [good or improving], and I practise daily by reading and speaking. I am ready to improve further as the job needs."
qde3c2e88.h: Bhashaon ki list sach batao. Roz practise karne ki baat karo.
qde3c2e88.q: How good is your English and Hindi? Do you know any other language?
qde3c2e88.w: Be honest. List the languages. Say you will practise daily.

qde66f085.a: For better customer service, I would take feedback from the customer and ask how we can improve in solving their problem and give them good service.
qde66f085.q: What will be your approach to improve customer service?

qde9bec41.a: Any business depends on the quality of service offered to the customer. To do this, you need to understand the customer's needs and problems, think from their point of view and try to meet their demands. This is customer satisfaction.
qde9bec41.q: What do you understand by "customer satisfaction"?

qe1adf577.a: Example (use your own): "My analysis showed that [cause] explained most of [problem]. I presented it to [team], and they changed [decision]. The result was [number]." Lead with the decision and the number.
qe1adf577.q: Tell me about a time your analysis changed a business decision.
qe1adf577.w: STAR. Lead with the decision and the number.

qe2bdc7c4.a: I confirm the alert and see which host and what data is involved, then isolate the host from the network while preserving evidence like memory and logs. I escalate to the incident lead, scope what was taken, block the IP, and prepare communication according to policy.
qe2bdc7c4.q: You see data leaving the network at 3 AM to an unknown IP. What now?
qe2bdc7c4.w: Confirm, isolate host, preserve evidence, escalate, scope the damage, communicate.

qe2f6ee2d.a: Example (use your own): "On a [project] we found a [payment rounding] bug one day before release. I reproduced it, wrote clear steps with logs, and told the developer and product owner at once. The fix went in the same day and we retested the full flow. After that I added an automated check for that case and a review step in the test plan so similar issues are caught earlier." Finish with the lesson.
qe2f6ee2d.q: Tell me about a critical bug you found late. What did you change after?
qe2f6ee2d.w: STAR format. End with a process change, not just the fix.

qe369b538.a: I try to stay focused on who I am and what I need. This helps me respond to change effectively. or (his longer answer): "Of course I can handle change. In my previous company, one of the bosses left. The new boss completely changed our strategy and project timings, and I was flexible and hard-working enough to manage it."
qe369b538.q: How well do you handle change?

qe40219de.a: Kotlin has null safety that avoids many crashes, shorter code, coroutines for async work and good Java interoperability. Google recommends Kotlin first for Android, and new libraries like Jetpack Compose are Kotlin-first.
qe40219de.q: Kotlin vs Java for Android: why Kotlin?
qe40219de.w: Null safety, shorter code, coroutines, official preference.

qe4885bc3.a: Depending on the situation, I can multi-task or handle one problem at a time. But multi-tasking has the upper hand because it increases efficiency in a call centre.
qe4885bc3.q: Do you like multi-tasking, or do you prefer to handle one problem at a time?

qe4996f89.a: .NET Framework is the old Windows-only version. .NET Core was the rewrite that is cross-platform, faster and open source. From .NET 5 onward it is simply called .NET, with yearly releases and long-term support versions. Modern .NET runs on Linux and containers and can run side by side with other versions. I would say which one my project uses and why migration helps.
qe4996f89.q: What is the difference between .NET Framework, .NET Core and modern .NET?
qe4996f89.w: Cross-platform, performance, side-by-side versions, say which you use and why you migrated.

qe72d4aa2.a: The customer applies with documents, the bank checks identity, income and credit score, then approves and sanctions the loan with terms. The customer signs the agreement, security or collateral is completed if needed, and the loan is disbursed to the account.
qe72d4aa2.q: How does a loan process work: from application to disbursal?
qe72d4aa2.w: Application, documents, credit check, approval, sanction, agreement, disbursal.

qe7edf9c7.a: I use SQL to join tables, filter and group data, to check that a report matches the source, to find missing or duplicate records, and to understand data before writing requirements. I use Excel and a BI tool for charts. I do not write production code, but I need enough SQL to answer questions without waiting for a developer.
qe7edf9c7.q: What SQL or data skills do you use as a BA?
qe7edf9c7.w: Joins, filters, validating reports, finding data gaps.

qe81db09b.a: NEFT, RTGS and IMPS are bank transfer systems with different rules for timing and limits; RTGS is for large amounts and is real time, IMPS is instant, and NEFT works in batches or round the clock under current rules. UPI is instant mobile payments linked to a bank account and works 24x7. I would confirm current limits from the bank's policy before telling a customer.
qe81db09b.q: What are NEFT, RTGS, IMPS and UPI?
qe81db09b.w: Speed, limits and timing in simple words. Say UPI is instant and 24x7.

qe8e60f45.a: Example structure (use your own): the problem, who the users were, my role, the research and the ideas I tested, the final design, and the result. I explain the reason for each choice and what I would change.
qe8e60f45.q: Walk me through a project in your portfolio.
qe8e60f45.w: Problem, your role, process, final design, result. Be ready to explain every choice.

qe8e7cc42.a: I have 4 years of experience in data entry, where I was responsible for entering, updating and maintaining accurate records in systems such as MS Excel and company databases. I am detail-oriented, fast at typing and careful about accuracy. Over the years, I have learned to handle large volumes of data under tight deadlines while keeping accuracy high. Now I am looking to join a company where I can continue to grow and take on more responsibility.
qe8e7cc42.w: Change the years and tools to match your own real experience.

qe962a5b0.a: 1. Independent. 2. Responsible. 3. Hard-working. 4. Multi-tasker. 5. Good learner.

qe9775a30.a: Example (use your own): "My team wanted to use a lower-cost supplier for an event. I listened to their concern first, then showed numbers on delays and quality from the earlier event. They agreed to try the better supplier, and the event ran on time." Show listening, facts and a clear result.
qe9775a30.q: Tell me about a time you convinced someone to agree with you.
qe9775a30.w: STAR. Show listening first, then a clear result.

qe9db9474.a: I interview the people who do the work and observe the current flow to draw the as-is process. I mark pain points, delays and manual steps, and find the gaps against the goal. Then I design the to-be flow with fewer steps, clear owners and system support, and define KPIs such as onboarding time and error rate. I validate both with stakeholders.
qe9db9474.q: Walk me through how you would map an as-is to to-be process for onboarding.
qe9db9474.w: Interviews, current flow, pain points, gaps, target flow, KPIs.

qe9e745f2.a: A list is ordered and changeable. A tuple is ordered and fixed, good for records and dictionary keys. A set holds unique values with fast membership checks. A dict stores key-value pairs with fast lookup by key. Example: use a set to remove duplicates, a dict to count words, a tuple for coordinates.
qe9e745f2.q: What is the difference between a list, tuple, set and dict?
qe9e745f2.w: Mutability, ordering, lookup cost, a typical use for each.

qea34c34d.a: Apologise and offer a better option. Act quickly and resolve the complaint. Take responsibility for what made the customer unhappy. Compensate with a better deal or free service.
qea34c34d.q: What steps will you take to deal with an unsatisfied customer?

qea93c5b9.a: "This depends on the airline and the airport. Usually check-in closes about 45 to 60 minutes before domestic departure and boarding closes earlier than the flight time. I would follow the airline's rule and tell the passenger exactly."
qea93c5b9.h: Airline par depend. Domestic check-in aam taur par 45-60 min pehle band hota hai.
qea93c5b9.q: When does check-in close and when does boarding close?
qea93c5b9.w: It varies by airline and airport. Domestic check-in usually closes around 45-60 minutes before departure. Say you would follow the airline's rule.

qeaf8532a.a: I look for qualities like intelligence, a good sense of humour and dedication to the team.
qeaf8532a.q: What qualities do you look for in your senior?
qeaf8532a.w: Pick 2-3 positive qualities, like guidance, fairness and support.

qeafcd60b.a: I check the sender, headers and links, detonate attachments or URLs in a sandbox, and search for who else received it and who clicked. I block the sender and domain, reset passwords and isolate affected devices where needed, remove the mail from mailboxes, and document and share lessons with users.
qeafcd60b.q: Walk me through how you would triage a phishing alert.
qeafcd60b.w: Headers, URLs, sandbox, affected users, block, reset, report, lessons.

qed1aeaa4.a: I compare definitions first: gross or net, dates, filters, currency, refunds. Then I compare the data sources and the join logic and reconcile step by step to find the difference. I fix or document it and agree one official definition and source of truth with the owners.
qed1aeaa4.q: Two reports show different revenue numbers. What do you do?
qed1aeaa4.w: Definitions, filters, sources, reconcile, document the single source of truth.

qed574a87.a: Yes, I am not only reliable but also very dependable. If a task is assigned to me, it will be handled properly and completed within the deadline.
qed574a87.q: Are you reliable? Can I trust you with responsibilities?

qef0e33fa.a: I double-check my work before submission, use built-in tools like spell check or data validation, and follow a checklist. If I am unsure about any data, I always clarify with my supervisor or the source before continuing.
qef0e33fa.q: How do you ensure accuracy in your work?
qef0e33fa.w: Change the years and tools to match your own real experience.

qef155a14.a: I separate layers: routes or views, services with business logic, and a data layer. Settings come from environment variables, with separate configs per environment. I use dependency injection in FastAPI, migrations for the database, linting and type hints, and tests in CI. A clear folder structure and a README help new team members start fast.
qef155a14.q: How do you structure a FastAPI or Django project for a team?
qef155a14.w: Layers, settings, dependency injection, tests, migrations.

qf21fb31e.a: A lead is someone who may be interested, for example a person who filled a form. A prospect is a lead I have qualified: they have a need, a budget and the authority to buy, and the timing fits. A customer has bought. I qualify using budget, authority, need and timeline.
qf21fb31e.q: What is the difference between a lead, a prospect and a customer?
qf21fb31e.w: Lead: possible interest. Prospect: qualified and fits. Customer: bought. Mention qualifying with budget, need and timeline.

qf30e392d.a: I use MoSCoW (must, should, could, won't) together with business value versus effort. I sit with the sponsor and key stakeholders to explain the trade-offs: if this goes first, that moves later. Then I record the agreed order and the reason in the backlog so everyone sees the same priority.
qf30e392d.q: How do you prioritize requirements when everything is urgent?
qf30e392d.w: MoSCoW, value vs effort, stakeholder alignment, trade-off conversation.

qf46d0197.a: Overfitting means the model learns the training data too closely and performs poorly on new data. I notice a big gap between training and validation scores. I prevent it with more data, regularisation, a simpler model, early stopping and cross-validation.
qf46d0197.q: What is overfitting and how do you prevent it?
qf46d0197.w: Train vs validation gap, regularization, more data, cross-validation, simpler model.

qf4a4e4e7.a: A VM includes a full guest operating system on a hypervisor, so it is heavier and starts in minutes. A container shares the host kernel and packages only the app and its libraries, so it is light and starts in seconds. VMs give stronger isolation; containers give speed, density and consistency across environments.
qf4a4e4e7.w: Isolation level, startup, resource use, when each fits.

qf5558aac.a: For SQL injection I use prepared statements with PDO and never join user input into SQL. For XSS I escape output with htmlspecialchars (or Blade's escaping) and validate input. For forms I add CSRF tokens.
qf5558aac.q: How do you prevent SQL injection and XSS in PHP?
qf5558aac.w: Prepared statements with PDO, escape output, validate input, CSRF tokens.

qf70d2365.a: I look at Crashlytics for the stack trace and the device and OS version pattern. I reproduce on an emulator with the same version, check memory, permissions and API level differences, fix it and test on those versions before releasing.
qf70d2365.q: Your app crashes on some devices only. How do you debug?
qf70d2365.w: Crashlytics logs, reproduce on emulator, OS versions, memory, permissions, fix and test.

qf8283643.a: I check the transaction status in the system, tell the customer politely that failed transactions are usually reversed automatically within the time set by bank rules, and raise a ticket with the reference number. I follow up if it is not reversed and keep the customer informed.
qf8283643.q: A customer's transaction failed but money is debited. What do you do?
qf8283643.w: Check status, explain reversal timeline, raise a ticket, follow up, keep the customer informed.

qf9334464.a: "I would stay polite and explain that the check-in counter has closed as per the rule. I would check with my supervisor if any option is possible and help the passenger to rebook on another flight."
qf9334464.h: Politely rule batao, supervisor se poochho, rebook mein madad.
qf9334464.q: A passenger arrives late after check-in closed. What will you do?
qf9334464.w: Stay polite, explain the rule, check with the supervisor if any option exists, help them rebook.

qf96dbe8c.a: I find the failing document and root cause, correct it with a proper reversal and repost (not by deleting), and tell the finance team the impact on the close. I add a check or validation to prevent a repeat.
qf96dbe8c.q: A month-end close fails because of a posting error. How do you handle it?
qf96dbe8c.w: Find the document, root cause, correct with proper reversal, inform finance, prevent a repeat.

qfa656e56.a: Personal accounts: debit the receiver, credit the giver. Real accounts: debit what comes in, credit what goes out. Nominal accounts: debit expenses and losses, credit incomes and gains. Example: paying rent of Rs 5,000 in cash means debit Rent (expense) and credit Cash (what goes out).
qfa656e56.q: What are the golden rules of accounting?
qfa656e56.w: Personal, real and nominal accounts with the debit and credit rule for each, with one example.

qfa9ab197.a: I list the missing invoices and follow up with the parties today. If company policy allows, I book a provision for the expenses so the books are fair, and I tell my manager what is pending and when it will be fixed.
qfa9ab197.q: Month-end is tomorrow and some invoices are missing. What do you do?
qfa9ab197.w: List the missing items, follow up now, book provisions if policy allows, tell your manager.

qfac4c758.a: Example: "I like [airline] because of its [good service, network or reputation for safety]. It flies to [routes or base cities], and I would be proud to represent the brand." Read about the airline's routes, base and values before the interview and say one real thing.
qfac4c758.h: Airline ke baare mein padho: routes, base city, service. Ek cheez jo pasand hai.
qfac4c758.q: Why do you want to join our airline?
qfac4c758.w: Read about the airline: routes, base cities, service style, fleet. Say one thing you like.

qfaed8718.a: Example (use your own): "A database ran out of disk and the app was down for 20 minutes. I freed space, restored service, and told stakeholders every 10 minutes. Afterwards I wrote a blameless post-mortem, added disk alerts at 80 percent and automated cleanup." Show timeline, fix and prevention.
qfaed8718.q: Tell me about an outage you handled.

qfaf1d674.a: I treat rejection as information. I ask politely why, improve my pitch from the feedback and keep my daily activity up. Every sales person hears more no than yes, and I focus on the number of good conversations I can control.
qfaf1d674.w: Treat it as data, ask why, improve the pitch, keep your daily call count up.

qfbbb7a9c.a: I first add a few characterization tests around the part I will change so I know the current behaviour. Then I make small safe steps, avoid wide refactors, and keep changes reviewable. I tell my manager clearly what is risky and what is not covered by tests, and add tests for the new feature itself.
qfbbb7a9c.q: You inherit an untested legacy codebase and must add a feature in a week.
qfbbb7a9c.w: Characterization tests around the change, small safe steps, communicate risk.

qfbced27e.a: My short-term goal is to fulfil my parents' dreams.

qfbd1f0c9.a: Google Analytics shows how people find and use a website. Daily I check traffic sources, top pages, user behaviour, and conversions or events in GA4. I look for sudden changes and find the reason.
qfbd1f0c9.q: What is Google Analytics and what do you check daily?
qfbd1f0c9.w: Traffic sources, user behavior, conversions, goals. Mention GA4.

qfc4b5df9.a: "I would not argue with the passenger. I would follow the procedure and call security and my supervisor. I would keep the passenger's information private."
qfc4b5df9.h: Bahas nahi. Procedure, security/supervisor, jaankari private.
qfc4b5df9.q: What do you do if a passenger is on the no-fly or security-flagged list?
qfc4b5df9.w: Do not argue. Follow the procedure and call security or the supervisor. Keep the passenger's information private.

qfd345981.a: If you have experience, describe it. If you do not, say: once training is provided, I can handle multiple calls with ease.
qfd345981.q: Can you handle multiple calls at the same time?
qfd345981.w: Never claim experience you do not have.

qfda1ba22.a: The lifecycle is onCreate (set up the UI), onStart (visible), onResume (interactive), onPause (partly hidden, save light state), onStop (not visible, release resources), onDestroy (final cleanup). Rotation recreates the activity, so I keep data in a ViewModel and save small state.
qfda1ba22.w: onCreate, onStart, onResume, onPause, onStop, onDestroy. Say what you do in each.

qfe33cc8d.a: Unit tests for pure functions with Jest or Vitest, component tests with Testing Library that behave like a user, and a few end-to-end tests with Playwright or Cypress for critical flows like login and checkout. I mock network calls at the boundary, not the component internals. Example: [name a real test you wrote].
qfe33cc8d.q: How do you test frontend code?
qfe33cc8d.w: Unit, component, e2e, what you mock, one real example.

qff73476c.a: A CIBIL score is a credit score, usually from 300 to 900, based on repayment history and credit use. Banks use it to decide loan approval and the interest rate. A higher score means better chances and rates.
qff73476c.q: What is a CIBIL score and why does it matter?
qff73476c.w: Credit score range 300 to 900, affects loan approval and rate.

qff92edde.a: Transient creates a new instance each time, scoped one per request, singleton one for the whole app. Example: a logger as singleton, a DbContext as scoped, a light helper as transient. A common bug is injecting a scoped service into a singleton, which keeps it alive too long.
qff92edde.q: Explain dependency injection lifetimes: transient, scoped, singleton.
qff92edde.w: One example each, and the captive dependency bug.

qffa3c824.a: I rate my leadership skills 8 out of 10. There is much to learn, but I have always taken the lead. For example, [your example from school, college, sports, NCC or a group project].
qffa3c824.q: On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate yourself as a leader?
qffa3c824.w: Use one real example of leading a group. Do not copy someone else story.

qffb5b7a2.a: Listen actively. Rephrase their concerns. Give a workable solution. Take action and follow up. Fix the problem immediately. Use the feedback. Reduce unpleasant situations by doing proper research and preparation.
qffb5b7a2.q: How do you deal with a difficult customer?
